title: Quote-Refresh Relief on Trade-In Payoff Per Diem
content:
An older payoff quote relieves the customer of some per diem in the **Trade-In Agreements** lien payoff charge.

### What is quote-refresh relief?

A number of days of per diem the customer is relieved of when the payoff relies on an older quote. The days relieved are taken off the customer's per-diem days, which never fall below none.

### What decides it?

The age of the quote relied on, counted in calendar days from its quote date to the send date.

| Age of the quote on the send date | Relief days |
|---|---|
| 9 days or more | 2 |
| At least 7 days but under 9 days | 1 |
| Under 7 days | None |

### Where are the boundaries?

| Age | Relief days |
|---|---|
| 6 days | None |
| 7 days | 1 |
| 8 days | 1 |
| 9 days | 2 |

### Worked example (hypothetical)

A quote dated the 2nd relied on for a payoff sent on the 11th is 9 days old: 2 days of per diem are relieved. If the customer had 3 per-diem days, 1 remains; if the customer had 1 per-diem day, none remain.
